name: Secure physical storage
description: The adversary is trying to store physical information or hardware securely to prevent theft, unauthorised access or manipulation.

subtechniques.name: Avoid storing sensitive information on magnetic storage
subtechniques.description: Use USB instead which can be destroyed/shredded more easily than magnetic harddrives.

subtechniques.name: Physical concealment
subtechniques.description: Physically concealing assets, such as USB-sticks.

subtechniques.name: Physical safe
subtechniques.description:
Physical safe’s might be deployed to securely store information or hardware.

subtechniques.name: Store devices
subtechniques.description: To prevent unauthorized access, theft and tampering, devices should be stored out of sight and shouldn’t be easily found.

subtechniques.name: Fake or hollow walls and floors
subtechniques.description: Fake and/or hollow walls and floors might be used to hide stuff.
